source.path: Wolfe et al. /Wolfe et al experimental data.csv

experiment: 48ml total per landscape, 4He versus 4Ho and 6He versus 6Ho, three matrix-transfer levels x three local-transfer frequencies, four intended microcosms each arm
outcome: day21 within-metacommunity generalist Stentor and any specialist Didinium or Dileptus both present (not within-patch colocation)
confounding: 4-patch size contrast uses 16/8 vs 12 ml; 6-patch uses 12/4 vs 8 ml; patch count and heterogeneity dose not independently identified

analysis.cell: within same patch count,matrix,corridor, heterogeneous minus homogeneous positive proportion
analysis.missing: bound all 5 unknown or unassigned binary outcomes adversarially
analysis.corridor: average three matrix strata with equal weights
analysis.exploratory_focal: 6-patch local-low-frequency vs local-high-frequency difference in heterogeneity contrasts; posthoc
